title: horkelia clevelandii
intro: Horkelia clevelandii, commonly known as Cleveland's horkelia, is a perennial plant species native to the Pacific Northwest region of North America. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Horkelia clevelandii include wound healing, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as phenolic compounds and flavonoids. However, there is limited research available on the specific bioactive constituents of Horkelia clevelandii, and further studies are necessary to fully understand its effects and benefits.
